def greedy_is():
    remaining = set(range(n))
    iset = []
    while remaining:
        # pick vertex with min degree in remaining subgraph
        best = min(remaining, key=lambda v: len(adj[v] & remaining))
        iset.append(best)
        remaining.remove(best)
        remaining -= adj[best]
    return iset
